items.title: A Practical Quantum Solver for Multidimensional Partial Differential Equations
items.authors: Manu Chaudhary, Kareem El-Araby, Alvir Nobel, Ishraq Islam, Manish Singh, Sunday Ogundele, Kieran Egan, Sneha Thomas, Vincent Vordtriede, Devon Bontrager, Serom Kim, Esam El-Araby
items.summary: This work introduces a faster, more accurate, and scalable quantum algorithm for solving multidimensional PDEs, outperforming VQA-based methods on IBM simulators and showing promising results on real quantum hardware.

items.title: Quantum Circuit Synthesis Using Fuzzy-Logic-Assisted Genetic Algorithms
items.authors: Ishraq Islam, Vinayak Jha, Sneha Thomas, Kieran F. Egan, Alvir Nobel,Serom Kim, Manu Chaudhary, Sunday Ogundele, Dylan Kneidel, Ben Phillips, Manish Singh, Kareem El-Araby, Devon Bontrager, Esam El-Araby
items.summary: This paper uses a fuzzy-logic-assisted genetic algorithm to synthesize hardware-ready quantum circuits, optimizing approximation error, multi-qubit gate count, and circuit depth for efficient execution on noisy NISQ devices.

items.title: A Practical Quantum Solver for Multidimensional Partial Differential Equations
items.authors: Manu Chaudhary, Kareem El-Araby, Alvir Nobel, Vinayak Jha, Dylan Kneidel, Ishraq Islam, Manish Singh, Sunday Ogundele, Ben Phillips, Kieran Egan, Sneha Thomas, Devon Bontrager, Serom Kim, Esam El-Araby
items.summary: This paper proposes two efficient quantum-circuit-based methods for solving multidimensional PDEs, achieving better accuracy, scalability, and runtime than VQA solvers on IBM simulators and real quantum hardware.
